I added `from __future__ import annotations` to all 20 modules in `shop/carriers/` (`acme.py` through `tundra.py`) and left `__init__.py` alone. The diff is just those 20 added lines.

In every module the new line goes right after the module docstring and before `import re`, so it's the first import. Python requires `__future__` imports to come after the docstring, so this is the earliest valid spot, and the TODO comment and docstring at the top of each file are unchanged.

**Tests:** All 6 passed. pytest isn't installed here, so I ran them with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`. None of the tests import the carrier modules, so the suite doesn't check this change. To cover that, I imported all 20 carrier modules directly and they all loaded without errors.

I haven't committed anything.
